reason: In the semiconductor sense, fonderie de semi-conducteurs is a domain term and must not be reduced to an ordinary metal foundry.
Microprocesseur is a transparent, ubiquitous technical cognate with predictable gender and no construction selected by the prompt.
Nanomètre is a transparent SI unit already familiar at C1, and its regular masculine gender adds too little teaching value.

Although the English prompt is elliptical, the fabless semiconductor business model supports a production-ready French noun phrase and a genuine register choice.
Système sur puce is an established compound, normally paired with SoC, and denotes more than an ordinary microprocessor.
La loi de Moore is a familiar, compositionally transparent proper-name expression with no further production difficulty here.
Circuit intégré is a transparent and ubiquitous electronics term with ordinary masculine gender and regular modification.
Réseaux neuronaux is now familiar core AI vocabulary, directly cognate and morphologically predictable.
Apprentissage profond is the recommended French field name and usefully contrasts with the widespread English loan deep learning.
Apprentissage automatique is an established nonliteral term vulnerable to an English-shaped apprentissage machine calque.
Données d’entraînement fixes the machine-learning sense and supports a useful distinction from the narrower jeu d’entraînement.
Algorithmes is a transparent, ubiquitous computing cognate with predictable masculine plural morphology.
The French discipline name adds automatique and conventionally yields TALN, so the legacy gloss is incomplete and English NLP should not be imported.

Apprentissage par renforcement is a fixed nonliteral construction whose preposition and technical sense merit active practice.
Éthique de l’IA is a transparent and now familiar technology-policy compound, and the prompt selects no narrower framework.
Apprentissage supervisé is compositionally transparent, established core AI vocabulary with regular adjective agreement.
Apprentissage non supervisé is compositionally transparent and differs from the familiar supervised term only by regular negation.
Modèle is a transparent, high-frequency cognate, while the isolated prompt provides no basis for choosing a specialized AI sense.
Logistique is transparent, ubiquitous business vocabulary already below C1 and carries no special construction here.
Supply-chain inventory is stock or stocks; French inventaire normally denotes stocktaking or its resulting list, so the legacy cognate is misleading.
French distinguishes the purchasing function from physical replenishment, whereas legacy approvisionnement collapses the two processes.
The logistics method is the hyphenated noun le juste-à-temps, not the everyday adverbial phrase juste à temps.
Distribution is a transparent, familiar logistics cognate with regular morphology and no narrower channel or process specified.
Logistique externalisée and the industry label 3PL name a specialist service model; legacy logistique des tiers is not idiomatic French.
Lead time requires a context-specific French délai compound and should not be treated as an English-shaped generic duration.
Sourcing fournisseurs specifically foregrounds identifying and selecting suppliers, which legacy approvisionnement wrongly broadens to obtaining supplies.
A SKU is an internal article reference, not the stock-management process suggested by a literal expansion, and it must be distinguished from EAN or GTIN.
Prévision de la demande is a productive planning collocation whose fixed noun and preposition carry useful professional vocabulary.
Effet coup de fouet is a fixed specialist metaphor for demand amplification; the capitalized legacy English loan is not the best French rendering.
Intégration verticale is a compositionally transparent and familiar business-policy term with ordinary gender and adjective agreement.
Externalisation is the idiomatic nonliteral French business term and must be distinguished from the narrower relationship of sous-traitance.
Transport is familiar core vocabulary with a direct translation and no selected modal, legal or logistics-specific sense.
Entreposage names the professional warehousing operation and usefully contrasts with stockage, which foregrounds keeping goods in storage.
Nœud is a productive noncognate technical term, and nœud logistique fixes the network sense selected by the surrounding supply-chain vocabulary.
Routine status tracking is suivre or assurer le suivi de, while tracer concerns traceability; the legacy infinitive is also malformed.
Marginaliser is a transparent, familiar critical verb with regular conjugation and no special complement selected by the prompt.
Tirer profit de supplies the governed preposition and intended benefit sense, which a bare profiter headword leaves underspecified.
